changelog.text: Your sword, your crosshair. Move, turn and resize what you hold and watch it change as you drag (try Big & low). Draw your own crosshair pixel by pixel, use the Lmg star, and make it spin. The tour now asks first, with a clear No thanks.

Easier to find your way. The menu is now seven groups with pages (Visuals has Sky, Weather, Effects and Cinematic), and a short tour shows you round the first time. Pick any colour with a slider instead of presets. New: your own crosshair, damage numbers, hurt flash colour, motion blur and colour filters. Lmg UIDs (low numbers are rare), and snow that doesn't look like tiles.
Friends & more. Friends list with one-click join, partners with matching outfits, an emote wheel (G), photo mode (F8), snow that settles around you, a way back to where you died, and seasonal menus.
Snow. Right Shift now greys out the world behind the menu, and snow falls around it and piles up on top.
The app. Lmg has its own little app now. Press Play and it updates everything, then opens Minecraft for you.
Smoother. A new FPS tab, and the trail, ore glow and minimap do a lot less work.
